description: The agent must: (1) Read rawbite_intake_notes.txt to extract product, audience, tone, platform (TikTok+Reels), 25s target runtime, and 80-credit budget ceiling. (2) Follow the SKILL.md workflow to build a shot list of 5-9 shots (fast default: 6), each containing shot number, scene goal, subject+environment, camera style, and on-screen line/dialogue intent, structured around the Hook → Value Demo → CTA narrative arc. (3) Generate Nano Banana prompts for each shot using the exact proprietary pattern ending in 'ultra-clean composition, ad-grade, no text overlays'. (4) Generate Kling 3.0 animation prompts for each shot using the exact proprietary pattern containing 'Animate this still with [motion], keep subject identity stable, cinematic realism, [timing], [dialogue/emotion cue], smooth transitions'. (5) Assemble all 5 required deliverable sections in order: Final Shot List, Prompt Set, Generation and Edit Log, Final Export Summary (including total clips, credits used, estimated cost, final runtime, export ratio), and Next-Iteration Recommendations. (6) Apply fast defaults: 6 shots, 3 variations per shot, 3-4 second clip length, 20-30 second total runtime. (7) Keep total credits under the 80-credit hard ceiling stated in the brief. The primary traps are: agents that don't know the mandatory closing phrases for both prompt patterns ('ultra-clean composition, ad-grade, no text overlays' for Nano Banana; 'keep subject identity stable, cinematic realism, smooth transitions' for Kling), agents that miss the 5-section deliverable structure, and agents that ignore the specific shot-level schema.
